title: Weak service hardening (chmod) — review required
description: chmod weakens a hardening control: chmods*=s*07(?:[0-7][1-7]|[1-7][0-7]). Each relaxation widens local or network impact. This lexical rule flags the setting; the reviewer restores 0700 socket mode.
limitation: Lexical, line-based: matches the setting regardless of host trust.
